objects.description: [Indian Critical Infrastructure Intrusions](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0043) included the use of compromised infrastructure, such as DVR and IP camera devices, for command and control purposes in [ShadowPad](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0596) activity.(Citation: RecordedFuture RedEcho 2022)
objects.description_fa: [Indian Critical Infrastructure Intrusions](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0043) شامل استفاده از زیرساخت‌های در معرض خطر، مانند دستگاه‌های دوربین DVR و IP، برای اهداف فرمان و کنترل در فعالیت [ShadowPad](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0596).[[CTI_PRESERVE_0] (Citation: RecordedFuture RedEcho 2022)
